about: Build tasks for agents. One task = one branch = one PR. Fields: area (data/areas.json id), priority 1 (first) to 3, kind, photos to build from (public/photos-ref), build (what to make), avoid (what not to do), accept (checks that must pass, beyond the standard set in docs/HANDOVER.md), dependsOn (task ids), status open | in-progress | done, owner (agent or person working on it), issue (GitHub issue number in daveyboyc/villacana-venture; close it from the task's PR). scripts/build_references.py turns this into refs/QUEUE.md, per-area task lists, graph nodes and issue bodies in refs/issues/.
